Our Community

Moon Bay OPC is more than a registration service — it’s a living ecosystem of international entrepreneurs, local mentors, and industry partners growing together in Suzhou.

Our Vision

A Home Court for Global Founders in China

We believe the hardest part of starting up in China shouldn’t be the paperwork — it should be the ambition of your idea. That’s why every founder who registers through Moon Bay OPC joins a network built to turn a foreign market into familiar ground. Here, mentors who’ve already navigated the journey stand beside you, partners open doors, and fellow founders become collaborators. Company registration is just the beginning; the community is the engine that keeps you moving.

The Ecosystem

Three Forces, One Network

Our community brings together the people who make great companies possible.

Entrepreneurs

Founders from around the world building companies across tech, services, and trade. You bring the vision — we bring the runway and the room to grow it.

Mentors

Experienced operators, investors, and alumni founders who’ve already navigated China’s market and now guide the next wave with one-on-one advice and hard-won lessons.

Industry Partners

Banks, law firms, recruiters, and suppliers — each vetted to give members fast, trusted access to the essential services a growing company depends on.
